title: How Far Does Online RL Generalize in Mobile GUI Agents? A Controlled Study with AndroidWorld-Generalization
abstract: arXiv:2603.07432v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Online reinforcement learning (RL) has advanced mobile GUI agents on AndroidWorld to over 80\% success, but these systems train and evaluate in the same environment, and their training tasks are not released for auditing. How far RL generalizes beyond its training contexts therefore remains unmeasured. We formalize the mobile environment as a Contextual MDP and instantiate a ladder of three progressively distant context shifts as AndroidWorld-Generalization: Unseen Instance, Unseen Template, and Unseen Application, with separation verified manually. In addition, we provide an open RL training system that makes studies at this scale feasible. Applying the identical RL algorithm to two priors of different origin and competence, UI-TARS-7B-SFT at 23.0\% and Qwen3-VL-8B at 52.6\%, we find that RL improves both in distribution but that gains fall monotonically up the ladder (+17.5/+11.1/+4.2 and +10.3/+7.4/+0), with training perform

translated_title: 在线强化学习在移动GUI智能体中的泛化能力有多远？基于AndroidWorld-Generalization的受控研究
translated_abstract: 在线强化学习（RL）已将AndroidWorld上移动GUI智能体的成功率提升至80%以上，但这些系统在相同环境中进行训练和评估，且其训练任务未公开以供审计。因此，RL在训练环境之外的泛化能力究竟如何仍无从衡量。我们将移动环境形式化为上下文马尔可夫决策过程，并构建了一个由三级渐进式远离的上下文偏移组成的阶梯，即AndroidWorld-Generalization基准：未见实例、未见模板和未见应用，并人工验证了各层级之间的区分度。此外，我们还提供了一个开放的RL训练系统，使这一规模的研究成为可能。将相同的RL算法应用于两个来源与能力各异的初始模型——成功率为23.0%的UI-TARS-7B-SFT和成功率为52.6%的Qwen3-VL-8B——我们发现RL在分布内均可提升两者的性能，但增益随阶梯逐级单调衰减（分别为+17.5/+11.1/+4.2和+10.3/+7.4/+0），训练表现……
tldr: 本文提出AndroidWorld-Generalization基准，通过未见实例、未见模板、未见应用三级递进的上下文偏移系统评估在线RL在移动GUI智能体中的泛化能力，发现RL收益随环境偏移距离增大而单调衰减。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces AndroidWorld-Generalization, a benchmark with three progressively distant context shifts (Unseen Instance, Unseen Template, Unseen Application), revealing that online RL gains in mobile GUI agents decay monotonically as the context shift increases.
